result.summary: The page is largely intact, but the bottom navigation area looks visually broken: a thick dark horizontal bar/line runs across the tab icons, making the search and cart area appear struck through or overlapped. Excluded edge-clipped carousel items and viewport-cut cards are not reported.

issues.description: A dark horizontal bar/line overlaps the bottom tab bar across the search/cart icons, making the navigation controls look crossed out or partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom safe-area inset/padding and ensure the app tab bar renders above the system navigation/gesture area without overlap.
